findings.summary: `assert doc["finding_count"] >= 1` is true regardless of whether dedup works (5 raw findings would also satisfy `>= 1`), so it adds nothing. The real verification is the two `ids.count(...)` assertions on the next lines, which are sound — this one line is just dead weight, not a gaming risk.
